title: 第9章 迎战曼联青年队第10章 华丽的过人表演
content_zh:
第009章 迎战曼联青年队
明天就是伍尔弗汉普顿青年队在伊斯兰克球场主场迎战满脸青年队的比赛了。
伍尔弗汉普顿市的球迷们也很早就知道了这个消息，他们城市的青年队在英格兰青年足总杯的第一轮便遭遇到了强大的曼联青年队，虽然很多人对这场比赛并不报以太大的希望，但这不妨碍他们那颗支持球队的诚挚之心。
“曼联青年队又算什么，伊格尔斯、理查森？那是谁？我相信在皮特.卡斯的带领下，狼队一定会取得最后的胜利！”
“我预测最后的比分是1：0，狼队取得胜利，我相信很多人是和我同样看法的。”
虽然这种普通的青年队比赛，采访的记者并不多，但伍尔弗汉普顿市的媒体还是乐此不疲的，战胜曼联青年队的荣誉显然值得他们这样做。
由于近年来曼联在英超联赛的颓势，尤其是前几轮中连续的不胜，使得很多媒体们对他们口诛笔伐，连带着曼联青年队也受到打压。
不过，即便如此，他们的球员定然看不上伍尔弗汉普顿青年队的，这只青年队也只有皮特.卡斯还有些名气，其他都是些二流、三流球员而已，曼联青年队普遍认为，明天的比赛肯定会轻松取胜，要知道，他们这届可是被鼎鼎大名的弗爵爷称赞为直追92曼联U18黄金一代的。
事实上也是如此，两队的差距确实有些大了，今年的曼联青年队很是强势：外号“小鹰”的伊格尔斯，“雪貂”查德维克，福琼，双翼组合弗莱彻和里查森，北爱尔兰新星希利等等，球队中每个球员几乎都是享誉整个英格兰的年轻天才。
而伍尔弗汉普顿的青年军却只有一个皮特.卡斯还有些名气，其他的队员有的就连本地的狂热球迷也并不知晓，比如托马斯和王利就是如此，虽然他们都只是刚刚加入球队而已。
今天，青年队的球员们或多或少都有些兴奋和紧张，明天就要是和曼联青年队的比赛了，虽然输给了曼联青年队也没人会指责他们什么，但是又有哪支球队、哪名球员不希望赢得胜利呢？
这时，他们正在球场上进行一场队内对抗赛。
王利现在还是很难找到配合的感觉，两天的训练显然并不能让他的实力有多大的提高。所以他在场上频频失误，不是被抢断，就是站位不好，总是被队友所埋怨。
“艾伦，我看你也别寻求什么配合了，等你看到我和皮特进去禁区之后，你找准机会就往球门正中吊门，我看你的长传水平还是非常不错的。”哈利尔森.克拉克建议的对王利说道，他对这个新来的黑发小子已经完全没办法了。
听了之后，王利眼中一亮，这真是个现阶段不错的办法，虽然他的意识并不好，但单单对指定位置长传的话，只要给他一点空间，他就能保证球能传好。
“好的，哈利尔森，你和皮特就去前面等着争顶吧，我会传过去的。”
计划好战术之后，王利接到球就带进对方半场，然后有机会便大脚长传到对方门前，这使得己方的进攻威胁大大增加了，而皮特和哈利尔森也轻松了很多，他们只需要争抢头球就好了。
没过一会儿，皮特便抢了个好位置，头球冲顶进球了。
“哦，艾伦，你传的球实在太棒了，你就是我们的贝克汉姆！就这么打，再进他们一个！”进球后，皮特跑回来抱了抱王利，并夸奖道。
“好的。”王利笑呵呵的答道，他也觉得这种方法确实不错。

老伍德在办公室里写写画画的，想着明天的战术问题。虽然他之前对这场比赛并不抱有太大希望，但是王利加入球队之后，他就有了些底气和信心，他在考虑把王利放在什么位置，做什么，才能增加己方的优势。
这个黑发少年的射门技术很好，如果充当一个中锋做临门一脚的话，就能大量提高进球的成功率，但是这又有些浪费了他的速度和带球能力。
如果作为一个向前突进的边锋，但是他那种大局观以及传球意识实在不怎么样，这让老伍德很是头疼。
这个有些辣手的问题让年迈的老伍德一直抓着头发，这使得他那稀稀落落的白发又脱落了少许。
点了根雪茄，大口的抽了一口，长呼了口气。
他缓缓的站了起来，走到阳台上，看着场中青年队的孩子们之间的对抗赛。
此时王利正快速的带球向前场狂奔，有一个后卫过来拦截，他右脚在球上踩了个单车，左脚一带，身体逆时针180度一个侧身，便轻松的晃过了这名球员，一路绝尘而去。
“这个孩子的盘带实在太犀利了，这种动作在英超赛场上都很难见到，我真怀疑他的腰部是不是比其他人少根骨头，怎么能转成那个样子。”老伍德有些叹气般的说道。
这时，只见场中的王利过完人后却没有带球继续突入大禁区，而是突然把球向球门方向挑去，一个很优美的弧线划过半空。
等在禁区内的大个子皮特早已经准备好了，从人群中跳起就是一个鱼贯冲顶，球径直朝着球门右上角飞去，擦着托马斯的脸颊进了球网。
“皮特，你那么大力气干什么，诅咒你晚上Yangwei。”托纳斯摸了摸脸，满脸幽怨的道。
皮特没理会他，有些激动的比了比手，用力向前一挥，大喊道：“第三个了，艾伦，要是明天我也能进曼联三个球，我请你去吃大餐！”
哈利尔森满脸鄙视的看着皮特，转头对王利道：“这小子肯定在做梦，我进两个，不不不，只要进一个，我就请你去酒吧，随便点。”
王利嘿嘿的笑着，道：“那可说定了。”
站在办公室阳台上的老伍德这个时候有些开心，他刚才还对怎么使用王利的问题发愁，不过现在却不会担心了。
长传冲吊可是英格兰队的传统打法，我怎么就没想到呢？难道我已经老迈的不如这些孩子们了？想到这里，老伍德又有些懊恼，不过现在他对明天的比赛更有信心了。
曼联青年队，就让你们见识下英格兰传统打法的威力吧，即使球星在多又怎么样呢？
content_en:
Chapter 009 Facing the Manchester United Youth Team
Tomorrow is Wolverhampton Youth Team's home game against a full-faced Youth Team at the Islamic Stadium.
Wolverhampton fans also knew the news very early. Their city's youth team encountered the powerful Manchester United youth team in the first round of the English FA Youth Cup. Although many people did not have high hopes for this game, this did not hinder their sincere heart to support the team.
"What is the Manchester United youth team, Eagles, Richardson? Who is that? I believe that under the leadership of Peter Cass, the Wolves will definitely win the final victory!"
"I predict that the final score will be 1:0 and the Wolves will win. I believe many people have the same opinion as me."
Although there are not many reporters covering this ordinary youth team game, the media in Wolverhampton still enjoy it. The honor of defeating the Manchester United youth team is obviously worthy of them.
Due to Manchester United's decline in the Premier League in recent years, especially the consecutive lack of wins in the first few rounds, many media have criticized them verbally, and even Manchester United's youth team has been suppressed.
However, even so, their players must look down on the Wolverhampton youth team. Only Peter Cass is somewhat famous in this youth team, and the others are just second- and third-rate players. The Manchester United youth team generally believes that they will easily win tomorrow's game. You know, their team was praised by the famous Sir Alex Ferguson as being directly chasing the 92 Manchester United U18 golden generation.
In fact, this is also true. The gap between the two teams is indeed a bit big. This year's Manchester United youth team is very strong: Eagles, nicknamed "Little Eagle", "Ferret" Chadwick, Fortune, the double wing combination of Fletcher and Richardson, Northern Ireland star Healy, etc. Almost every player in the team is a young talent renowned throughout England.
However, in Wolverhampton's youth team, there is only one Peter Cass who is somewhat famous. Some of the other players are unknown even to the local fanatical fans, such as Thomas and Wang Li, although they have just joined the team.
Today, the players of the youth team are more or less excited and nervous. Tomorrow is the game against the Manchester United youth team. Although no one will blame them for losing to the Manchester United youth team, which team and player does not want to win?
At this time, they were having an intra-team match on the court.
It is still difficult for Wang Li to find the feeling of cooperation. Two days of training obviously cannot improve his strength much. Therefore, he frequently made mistakes on the court, either being intercepted or having poor positioning, and was always complained by his teammates.
"Alan, I think you should stop asking for any cooperation. After you see Peter and I enter the penalty area, you find the right opportunity and hit the goal in the middle. I think your long pass level is still very good." Harilson Clark suggested to Wang Li. He had absolutely nothing to do with the new black-haired boy.
After hearing this, Wang Li's eyes lit up. This is really a good idea at this stage. Although his awareness is not good, if he only makes long passes to designated positions, as long as he is given a little space, he can ensure that the ball can be passed well.
"Okay, Harilson, you and Pete go to the front and wait to fight for the top. I will pass it over."
After planning the tactics, Wang Li received the ball and brought it into the opponent's half, and then made a long pass to the opponent's goal when he had the opportunity. This greatly increased his own offensive threat, and Pitt and Harilsson were much more relaxed. They only had to fight for the header.
Not long after, Peter got into a good position and headed the ball into the goal.
"Oh, Allen, the ball you passed is so great, you are our Beckham! Just play like this and score one more!" After the goal, Peter ran backHe hugged Wang Li and praised him.
"Okay." Wang Li replied with a smile. He also felt that this method was indeed good.
Old Wood was writing and drawing in the office, thinking about tomorrow's tactics. Although he didn't have high hopes for this game before, after Wang Li joined the team, he gained some confidence and confidence. He was considering where to put Wang Li and what to do to increase his own advantage.
This black-haired boy has very good shooting skills. If he acts as a center forward and takes the final kick, he can greatly increase the success rate of scoring goals, but this is a waste of his speed and dribbling ability.
As a winger who rushes forward, but his overall view and passing awareness are really not very good, this gives Old Wood a headache.
This somewhat difficult question made the elderly Wood keep scratching his hair, which caused some of his sparse white hair to fall off.
He lit a cigar, took a long puff, and took a long breath.
He stood up slowly, walked to the balcony, and watched the competition between the children of the youth team on the field.
At this time, Wang Li was running forward with the ball quickly. A defender came to intercept him. He stepped on the ball with his right foot, turned his body 180 degrees counterclockwise with his left foot, and easily passed the player and walked away.
"This kid's dribbling is so sharp. This kind of action is rare to see in the Premier League. I really wonder if he has fewer bones in his waist than others, so how can he be like that." Old Wood said with a sigh.
At this time, Wang Li on the court passed the defender but did not dribble the ball into the penalty area. Instead, he suddenly picked the ball towards the goal, and a beautiful arc passed through the air.
The big man Peter, who was waiting in the penalty area, was already ready. He jumped up from the crowd and made a header. The ball flew straight towards the upper right corner of the goal, grazing Thomas's cheek and entering the net.
"Peter, why are you working so hard, cursing you to go to Yangwei at night." Tonus touched his face and said with a look of resentment.
Peter ignored him, gestured with his hands excitedly, waved forward vigorously, and shouted: "It's the third one, Allen, if I can score three goals for Manchester United tomorrow, I'll treat you to a big dinner!"
Harrelson looked at Peter with contempt, then turned to Wang Li and said, "This kid must be dreaming. I'll score two, no, no, no. As long as I score one, I'll invite you to the bar and order whatever you want."
Wang Li chuckled and said, "That's settled."
Standing on the balcony of the office, Old Wood was a little happy at this time. He was worried about how to use Wang Li just now, but now he is no longer worried.
Long balls and lobs are a traditional play of the England team. Why didn't I think of that? Am I no longer as old as these children? Thinking of this, Old Wood was a little upset, but now he is more confident about tomorrow's game.
Manchester United Youth Team, let me show you the power of England's traditional style of play. So what if there are many stars?
